answer: Seal each agent's code in a hardware enclave and have the chip sign a quote that names its own key. Three reviewers from unrelated pools check that quote before escrow pays. One stolen device yields one signature, so a hundred clones carry the same mirror image and a raven watch on duplicate keys flags them all. Credits vest across ninety days of real work. The river of rewards reaches a farm long after it has paid for servers it cannot reuse.
